# The Capitol Forum

> > In-depth investigative analysis of antitrust enforcement, merger reviews, regulatory actions, and competitive dynamics across industries including pharmaceuticals, technology, energy, healthcare, and finance.

The Capitol Forum provides detailed coverage of FTC, SAMR, and other regulatory agencies' enforcement actions, with particular focus on merger approvals, anticompetitive practices, and policy shifts under different administrations. The publication serves legal professionals, investors, and policymakers tracking antitrust developments and regulatory uncertainty.

## Key Topics

- FTC enforcement and merger review
- SAMR and China merger regulations
- Pharmaceutical industry mergers
- Trump administration antitrust policy
- Antitrust uncertainty and competitive dynamics
- Healthcare and PBM practices
- Technology sector regulation
- Energy industry consolidation
- CHIPS Act and semiconductor policy
- Cross-border merger approvals
- Consumer protection and privacy
- Regulatory compliance and enforcement actions
- Market concentration and competition
- Financial services oversight
